meta.design: R3-W2 leave-one-out test of Proposition 2: does arm length (max of the two generators' arms on the switched axis, from frozen r1 gaps) predict flip locations among the 57 checks? Single-threshold classifier trained on 56, predicts the held-out check. Permutation baseline 500 reps, seed 20260926. No new inference.

data.arm_def: max(arm_A, arm_B) on the switched axis per check

verdict: arm length carries flip-location information beyond class frequency: LOO accuracy 0.860 vs majority 0.772, permutation p=0.000, AUC 0.863 — the condition is not pure post-hoc description
